Targeting 60 MHz needs gm1~0.75 mS, which is ~55 uA per side at gm/Id 14 (tail ~110 uA). The single dominant pole and a mirror pole well above 500 MHz give PM >80 deg. Slew is ~55 V/us and tau ~2.7 ns, so 1% settling is ~15-20 ns. Headroom: tail Vds ~0.25 V, PMOS diode at ~0.7 V."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 20.0),    # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),      # input pair L
    "gbw_t": (62e6, 45e6, 120e6),   # design GBW target
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 14.0),      # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.4, 0.15, 1.5),      # PMOS mirror L
    "gmidt": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),     # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),       # tail L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8

    # input pair sized from GBW target
    gm1_req = 2 * PI * p["gbw_t"] * cl
    I1 = gm1_req / p["gmid1"]
    Itail = 2 * I1

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.55, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=1.0)        # diode side vsd ~ vsg
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.9)        # output side
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=0.25)    # tail
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)      # ibias diode (same gm/Id, L)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias sunk by diode nfet, mirrored to tail
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # input pair: vinp drives the output-side device -> non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load (diode on x)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A0 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m4.gds)
    cout = cl + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    sr = Itail / cout
    step = 0.5
    vlin = 2 * (I1 / gm1)  # linear range ~ 2/(gm/Id)
    t_slew = max(0.0, (step - vlin) / sr)
    settle = t_slew + tau * math.log(min(step, vlin) / (0.01 * step) + 1e-12)
    power = vdd * (Itail + iref)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "settle": settle, "power": power, "slew": sr}
```
